title: Stopping a microVM always waits out an eight-second ssh timeout
foundBy: session agent, comparing with another agent sandbox

evidence.verified: Five stops on a real microVM took 8.67 to 8.70 seconds before the fix and 0.92 to 1.0 seconds after. The guest's serial log still shows a clean reboot. go test ./internal/engine/ -count=20: TestRebootGuestReturnsWhenTheVMMExits PASS. The full `make ci` gate on the six commits together exited 0, with 14 of 14 agent replay cells passing on podman. `make test-agents-lent AGENTS_ENGINE=firecracker` passed 7 of 7.

resolution: `stop` runs the reboot ssh beside a poll of the VMM and cancels the ssh as soon as Firecracker exits (R73a).
details: `stop` asks the guest to reboot over ssh. A guest that reboots sends no FIN, so ssh waited its full eight-second timeout after the VM was already gone.
